Alex —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and for sending the SOW/invoice sample. Short answer: we can often accommodate a limited invoice-only path for pilots under $5k, but we need a couple of controls in place so Finance is comfortable.

Proposed approach:
- Temporary "preapproved invoice" lane for the pilot (up to $5k) — Finance signs off at team lead level.
- Required fields on the invoice: Redwood purchase contact (Ben Carter), description of services/period, line-level amounts, tax/VAT breakdown, supplier remit details, and an attached signed SOW or DocuSign summary.
- Evidence: vendor bank details + W-9 or country equivalent, and the SOW attached to the invoice thread.
- Duration: the lane would be active for 45 days from pilot activation; after that we either convert to a standard PO flow or renew the waiver.

Next steps for us: I can request an official one-off waiver from Procurement. Marissa — can you confirm whether a team-lead approval is sufficient or if Procurement/Finance needs a formal PO-exception ticket? Laura, I pasted you to flag any additional evidence Finance requires.

If you want to accelerate, Alex, send the signed SOW (DocuSign landing page or signed PDF) and confirm vendor tax docs and bank remit info. I’ll draft the waiver request once I get Marissa/Laura's input.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Ben / Marissa —

Finance is OK with a short-lived invoice-only activation for pilots under $5k provided the following checklist is complete. We prefer Procurement to issue the waiver formally so we have an audit trail.

Finance checklist for temporary invoice lane:
1) Signed SOW or Master Services Agreement (electronic signature accepted).
2) Vendor tax form (W-9 for US vendors) or VAT registration for EU vendors.
3) Vendor bank remit details + confirmation of account name.
4) Purchase contact and internal approver name + business justification for PO waiver.
5) A single invoice per pilot with clear dates and invoice number.
6) Waiver duration and renewal conditions (we recommend 45 days).

Procurement process: please open a PO-exception ticket in the procurement queue and attach items 1–4 above. For pilot-level waivers we can approve at Procurement manager level; exceptions above $5k require VP Finance.

Marissa — if you can create the ticket and tag me, I’ll turn around approval within 24 business hours once attachments are in place. Aditya — flagging since this is a pilot with potential expansion; let me know if you want to review the class of vendors we allow on the temporary lane.

Laura Bennett
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
